concerns.text: Plan.md defines a Phase 0 (Data Verification & Power Analysis) with several concrete steps (dataset‑gaze check, power analysis, memory check) but tasks.md contains no tasks for this phase, leaving the plan element unimplemented.

The implementation plan (plan.md) references a quickstart command (`python code/main.py --data-dir data/processed --output-dir results`). No task in tasks.md is tagged to implement or verify this quickstart step, so the plan’s end‑to‑end reproducibility checkpoint is uncovered.

The data‑model (data-model.md) defines core entities such as `epoch_id` and `subject_id`. Tasks.md does not contain any task explicitly creating, validating, or documenting these entities, resulting in missing traceability between the data model and implementation.
